d: Mrs. Drysdale recommends Elly for a high-brow finishing school in hopes that humiliating her will drive the Clampetts away
Cynthia Fenwick makes her filthy rich mother dress in the "Clampett Look" when they visit the Clampetts, since she thinks Elly is a fashion maven.
Jethro decides he wants to go a courtin', so after Jed gives him a little education he finds a woman, who happens to be a stripper
Jethro thinks he's in love with Chickadee Laverne, a stripper he met at the bank.
The Clampetts receive an overdraft from the bank intended for the deadbeat actor J.D. 'Jake' Clampett
When Jake Clampett tells Jed he's his cousin, he's welcomed into the home and soon has everyone but Jed thinking about and dressing for a role in their next movie.
Elly bonds with the Thanksgiving turkey so the family can't bring themselves to kill it.
Mrs. Drysdale has a garden party and 'invites' the Clampetts by mistake.
Mr. Drysdale needs investors for his real estate development project, so he enlists the Widow Fenwick
The Clampetts decide to get a taste of culture to fit in the high-class society of Beverly Hills.
Mr. Drysdale's idea for Christmas presents are ones only fit for coastal California
Granny tries to find the perfect man for Elly May.
Miss Hathaway's brilliant-but-frumpy bank protegee Gloria is really a sultry gold-digger with eyes for Jed's $34 million
When an IRS agent gets chased away by Granny, Mr. Drysdale tells him the story of how the Clampetts came to be rich and move to Beverly Hills.
When a couple who ran into the Clampett's car discover that they're rich, they fake injuries and sue the Clampetts.
Jethro needs a health certificate to graduate from the fifth grade, so he goes to the only doctor the Clampetts know about - Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist
Jethro finally gets his bill of health from Dr. Twombly so he can graduate the fifth grade, but Twombly really wants to talk to Grannie again
When Miss Hathaway gets sick and Mr. Drysdale has to speak at a conference, Jed helps out by running the bank and having Elly be his secretary
Jethro brings home a friend, Armstrong Dueser McHugh III, who is coddled by a chauffeur who treats him as frail.
Jed cheers up Granny by pretending to be sick so she can doctor him
After Granny cuts off the top of Drysdale and Clyburn's (his doctor) hair for some homegrown remedy, Clyburn tries to keep her from ever doctoring again
